description: One poem by its id (from find_poems or a poem page URL): title, poet, language, the number of lines and stanzas, the opening of the text (a poem of 1 to 3 lines whole), a short summary when the library has one, and the links to the full poem, its analysis (when there is one) and the trainer to learn it by heart.
name: get_poem
title: Get a poem
